about_the_game:
Created by the Devil to serve, you were meant to be just another curse.
But something went wrong, you woke up.

In Your Time Has Come, every contract is a sentence. Use cards to manipulate the environment and eliminate those who sold their souls, while the Devil tries to erase what remains of your consciousness.

Earn new cards, solve enigmas, and uncover the secrets hidden behind the malevolent smile of the one who created you.

Time is short. The clock is ticking.
And this time... their hour has come.

short_description: They traded everything for fame, money and power. You are the collector: build your deck, play cards, manipulate the environment and eliminate the humans. Make their time come.
